净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Free-float size conditions the re-rating elasticity of book-value cheapness. Smaller free-float stocks have higher sensitivity to fundamental improvements. A debt-to-assets screen protects against financial distress. The mechanism tests whether cheapness amplified by float context and filtered by health predicts returns.

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

(1 / pb_lf) * (1 / log(1 + free_float_shares)) * (1 - debttoassets/100)
依赖列: pb_lf, free_float_shares, debttoassets

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

(1 / pb_lf) * (1 / log(1 + free_float_shares)) * (1 - debttoassets/100)
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(multiply(divide(1, pb_lf), divide(1, log(add(1, free_float_shares)))), subtract(1, divide(debttoassets, 100)))
  2. 2. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(divide(1, pb_lf), divide(1, log(add(1, free_float_shares))))
  3. 3. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(1, pb_lf)
  4. 4. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(1, log(add(1, free_float_shares)))
  5. 5. log —— 取自然对数
    log(add(1, free_float_shares))
  6. 6. add —— 加法
    add(1, free_float_shares)
  7. 7. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(1, divide(debttoassets, 100))
  8. 8. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(debttoassets, 100)

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
debttoassets资产负债率（杠杆字段）

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 cheapness：1.0 / pb_lf
  2. 计算 float_adj：1.0 / np.log1p(free_float_shares.clip(lower=1e6))
  3. 计算 health：1.0 - debttoassets / 100.0
  4. 计算 factor：cheapness * float_adj * health
来源：由原始 Python 代码逐句翻译（字段/算子释义见下方）

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_float_conditioned_book_cheapness(df): df_copy = df.copy() "com"># Cheapness: 1 / pb_lf cheapness = 1.0 / df_copy["pb_lf"].replace(0, np.nan) "com"># Float context: smaller free-float implies higher re-rating elasticity float_adj = 1.0 / np.log1p(df_copy["free_float_shares"].clip(lower=1e6)) "com"># Health: low debt is positive health = 1.0 - df_copy["debttoassets"] / 100.0 "com"># Combine factor = cheapness * float_adj * health "kw">class="kw">return factor.rename("factor_float_conditioned_book_cheapness")
